name: api-governance
description: Signed, offline-verifiable authorization for AI-agent contract changes. Claude Code asks before a contract change proceeds; only a granted change can proceed. The verdict is deterministic — the same change set yields the same verdict, not a model's judgement — and branching is fail-closed: an unrecognised execution_action is not permission. Three MCP tools: preflight_change_set, verify_receipt, get_decision_details.

api_key.title: CodeRifts API key
api_key.description: Lets the mod ask CodeRifts to authorize a contract change (preflight_mode=authorize) instead of only analyzing it, and authenticates the coderifts MCP server. Sent only to https://app.coderifts.com, in the Authorization header. Leave empty to analyze without a key. Create one at https://coderifts.com/get-started/.
